jobs.summary: The Department of Biology is seeking a Visiting Professor to teach undergraduate courses in ecology and evolution for a one-year term. Key requirements include a Ph.D. in Biology or a related field and experience in teaching at the college level.

jobs.title: Visiting Professor of Philosophy
jobs.summary: The Department of Philosophy is seeking a Visiting Professor to teach undergraduate courses and contribute to departmental activities for a one-year term. Key requirements include a PhD in Philosophy and demonstrated excellence in teaching.
